items.informal_name: Leading Coefficient of Determinant of $ XA + B $ is Determinant of $ A $
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : CommRing α] (A B : Matrix n n α),
  (Polynomial.X • A.map ⇑Polynomial.C + B.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.coeff (Fintype.card n) = A.det
items.informal_description: For square matrices $ A $ and $ B $ over a commutative ring $ \alpha $, the coefficient of $ X^{\#n} $ in the determinant of the matrix $ X \cdot A + B $ (where entries are lifted to polynomials via constant embedding) is equal to the determinant of $ A $. Here $ \#n $ denotes the cardinality of the finite type $ n $.

items.informal_name: Constant Term of Determinant Polynomial for $XA + B$
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : CommRing α] (A B : Matrix n n α),
  (Polynomial.X • A.map ⇑Polynomial.C + B.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.coeff 0 = B.det
items.informal_description: For square matrices $A$ and $B$ over a commutative ring $\alpha$, the constant term (coefficient of $X^0$) of the determinant of the matrix polynomial $X \cdot A + B$ (where entries are treated as constant polynomials) is equal to the determinant of $B$.

items.informal_name: Determinant of a Matrix of Monic Polynomials with Degree Conditions Equals One
items.type:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) → (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.of fun i j => (p j).coeff ↑i).det = 1
items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ R $ and natural number $ n $, consider monic polynomials $ p_0, p_1, \ldots, p_{n-1} $ in $ R[X] $ where each $ p_i $ has degree $ i $. Construct an $ n \times n $ matrix $ M $ such that the entry in row $ i $ and column $ j $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p_j $. Then the determinant of $ M $ is equal to 1.

items.informal_name: Leading coefficient of determinant of X•I + A is 1
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : CommRing α] (A : Matrix n n α),
  (Polynomial.X • 1 + A.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.leadingCoeff = 1
items.informal_description: For an $ n \times n $ matrix $ A $ with entries in a commutative ring $ \alpha $, the leading coefficient of the determinant of the matrix $ X \cdot I + A $ (where $ X $ is the indeterminate, $ I $ is the identity matrix, and entries of $ A $ are embedded as constant polynomials) is equal to 1.

items.informal_name: Determinant Evaluation Commutes with Polynomial Evaluation for Matrices
items.type:
∀ {n : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type u_3} [inst_2 : CommRing R]
  (M : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) (r : R),
  Polynomial.eval r M.det = (Polynomial.eval ((Matrix.scalar n) r) (matPolyEquiv M)).det
items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ R $, an $ n \times n $ matrix $ M $ with entries in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $, and an element $ r \in R $, evaluating the determinant of $ M $ at $ r $ equals the determinant of the matrix obtained by evaluating each entry of $ M $ at the scalar matrix corresponding to $ r $, under the canonical isomorphism between matrices over $ R[X] $ and polynomials over matrices in $ R $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of $X$ in $\det(I + X M)$ Equals Trace of $M$
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {n : Type v} [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] [inst_2 : Fintype n] (M : Matrix n n R),
  (1 + Polynomial.X • M.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.coeff 1 = M.trace
items.informal_description: For any $n \times n$ matrix $M$ over a commutative ring $R$, the coefficient of $X$ in the determinant of the matrix $I + X M$ (where $X$ is the indeterminate in the polynomial ring $R[X]$) is equal to the trace of $M$. This identity connects the trace of a matrix to the linear term in the determinant expansion of $I + X M$.

items.informal_name: Vandermonde Determinant Equals Monic Polynomial Evaluation Determinant
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => Polynomial.eval (v i) (p j)).det
items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ R $, a vector $ v $ of length $ n $ with entries in $ R $, and a sequence of monic polynomials $ p_0, p_1, \ldots, p_{n-1} $ over $ R $ where each $ p_i $ has degree $ i $, the determinant of the $ n \times n $ Vandermonde matrix formed by $ v $ is equal to the determinant of the matrix whose $ (i,j) $-entry is $ p_j(v_i) $, the evaluation of polynomial $ p_j $ at $ v_i $. This equality holds under the conditions that each polynomial is monic and has natural degree equal to its index.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {n : Type v} [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] [inst_2 : Fintype n] (M : Matrix n n R),
  M.det = (-1) ^ Fintype.card n * M.charpoly.coeff 0
items.informal_description: For an $ n \times n $ matrix $ M $ over a commutative ring $ R $, the determinant of $ M $ equals $ (-1) $ raised to the cardinality of $ n $ multiplied by the constant term of the characteristic polynomial of $ M $. This identity connects the determinant directly to the leading coefficient of the characteristic polynomial, reflecting the relationship between matrix invariants and polynomial coefficients.
